messages:
Aditya Rao: Quick sync — Crescent's Dedicated -> VPC migration target is next Wed. Need a 30m deployment review + handoff. Who can join? @Maya @Lena @Oliver
Maya Chen: I can do Wed 11:00 PT (30m). Agenda suggestions: preflight checklist, canary plan, rollback.
Lena Park: I can do 9:30 or 11:00 PT, prefer 11. Please include Security and CSM for consent on data flows.
Oliver G: I'll join for networking/kernel concerns. Please add the runbook link and the expected canary metrics.
Aditya Rao: Proposed agenda:
1) Goal & success criteria (5m)
2) Infra readiness: VPC, routing, NAT, peering (8m)
3) Runbook walkthrough (5m)
4) Canary plan + metrics + alert thresholds (7m)
5) Open Qs & action items (5m)
Any additions?
Maya Chen: Add: validation steps for prefix/KV cache encryption and a quick smoke test for latency under 95th percentile. I'll prep a short network diagram.
deploy-bot: Note — runbook doc updated: https://go.redwood.internal/docs/crescent-dedicated-vpc-runbook (last edited by Oliver G).
Lena Park: Also need confirmation on compliance checklist: audit logging retention & KMS key access. Can security confirm?
Oliver G: CIDRs for peering are 10.20.0.0/16 (Redwood side) and 10.30.0.0/16 (crescent). KMS: we need to add service account `redwood-ops@crescent-prod` to the key policy and allow Encrypt/Decrypt. I'll open a PR this afternoon.
Aditya Rao: Perfect. I'll book the calendar for Wed 11:00 PT and invite Infra, Security, and the Crescent CSM. Action items before meeting:
- Maya: upload network diagram + validation steps (due Tue EOD)
- Oliver: PR for KMS key policy + confirm peering ACLs (due Tue EOD)
- Lena: confirm compliance checklist items with Security (due Tue EOD)
If anything else, drop it here.
Maya Chen: :thumbsup: I'll upload diagrams and a short checklist snippet.
Oliver G: I'll post the PR link once ready.
Lena Park: Adding Security: @Sarita (can you skim the checklist before Wed?)
Aditya Rao: Thanks everyone — calendar invite sent. Meeting note: bring any open deploy questions; we'll keep it tight.
Maya Chen: One more note — short commands to validate KV cache encryption in prod-like env: ```bash
# validate encryption enabled
redwoodctl config get --env crescent-staging | jq '.kv_cache.encryption'
# test a sample write/read
redwoodctl kv put testkey --value foo && redwoodctl kv get testkey
```
Oliver G: Saved — useful commands. See you all Wed.
